# Clarity Chat

> Clarity Chat is an iPhone and iPad app that reviews conversation screenshots for tone, emotional language and communication patterns. Its App Store name is Deep Conversations: Clarity.

Product facts checked against App Store version 1.10 and the published screenshots on 2026-09-13.

## When the app fits

- For a second look at an exchange: select up to four readable screenshots and receive a report with observations, concrete excerpts and reflective next steps.
- For conversations in WhatsApp, iMessage, Tinder or Instagram: the input is screenshots selected by the user, not automatic access to those accounts.
- For reviewing communication patterns: the report includes tone, participation, response patterns, a summary and suggested questions or boundaries.
- The app cannot read minds, prove intentions or diagnose a person. Missing context can change the interpretation of a screenshot.
- Free download with optional in-app purchases. Check the App Store for current device requirements and local prices.
- Review the privacy policy before submitting conversation material. This page does not claim that all AI processing happens on the device.

## Website languages

The website and published app support English, Spanish, French, German, Italian and Polish. Each website language includes the home page, seven guides, the guide index, privacy, terms and support. Product screenshots and captions follow the selected website language.

- English: https://claritychat.app/
- Español: https://claritychat.app/es/
- Français: https://claritychat.app/fr/
- Deutsch: https://claritychat.app/de/
- Italiano: https://claritychat.app/it/
- Polski: https://claritychat.app/pl/

Use the visible language selector to open the equivalent page in another language.
